notes:
Account snapshot:
- Org: Ironclad Banyan Software — mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). HQ: Berlin, DE. 300 employees.
- Buying committee: Tom Keller (Head of Product), Priya Rao (VP Infra), Sandrine Lefevre (Legal).
- Initial ask: replace brittle rules-based search + homegrown embeddings with hosted embeddings + chat for in-app support and document search.
POC plan and outcomes so far:
- 4-week hosted API POC running from EU region. POC scope: document search index (embeddings + reranking) and chat-based support assistant for billing workflows.
- Baseline results from hosted-eu: chat p50 ~120ms, p95 ~380ms. Embedding latency per request ~18ms. These meet product team's rough thresholds but infra wants p95 < 350ms for peak SLAs.
- Mid-POC ask: test Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) in eu-west region to evaluate tail latency improvements and predictable throughput. Team requested pricing delta for dedicated vs hosted (monthly reserved + overage).
- Data residency: legal requires EU-only data residency for customer content and audit logs. They want confirmation that control plane metadata can be restricted to EU, and keys stored in customer-managed KMS.
- Multi-region routing: product team wants active-active read-routing for users in EU + NA offices. Concern: routing to NA for failover will break residency constraints. Suggested approach: EU primary, NA fallback only for non-PII and with opt-in.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; acceptable ARR ~80k first year; strong focus on unit cost for embeddings (per-embedding) and cost per 1M tokens.
- Acceptance criteria for go/no-go:
  * Chat p95 <= 350ms under 90% of production-like load spikes
  * Embedding throughput >= 120 qps with acceptable cost per 1k requests
  * EU-only residency & KMS integration validated in security review
  * Pricing within estimated ARR band or committed reserved capacity to hit target unit economics
Sales/ops notes and next steps:
- SE Luca ran kernel-level profiling with hosted instance; concluded Dedicated with nvlink-enabled pool should reduce tail latency ~15-25% in our tests. SE asked infra to provide realistic peak qps patterns (action: Priya).
- Legal wants a short SOW for EU-only control plane and a data transfer diagram. We provided draft (drive://ironcladbanyan/security-faq.pdf).
- Pricing: shared pricing-deck-v2 with preliminary committed capacity options (drive://ironcladbanyan/pricing-deck-v2.pdf). Waiting on Tom's signal on which commit bracket.
- Quote from Tom on 02-02: "We need predictable latency for paid customers — spikes kill retention. If Dedicated can guarantee tails at scale, we can commit."
Open blockers:
- Confirm EU-only control plane + audit log retention period (legal)
- Finalize Dedicated pricing for the requested reserved GPU profile
- Clarify multi-region routing policy that preserves residency while enabling failover
Next meeting: 2026-03-16 (POC wrap) - agenda: show dedicated test numbers, deliver term sheet for EU-only Dedicated deployment, legal Q&A.
notes_short: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. EU data residency required; POC showing good baseline but need better p95 tail. Legal needs EU-only control plane + KMS. Next: Dedicated test numbers and pricing term sheet.
